summary.plain: The international team of scientists who built and ran the PHENIX heavy-ion experiment at Brookhaven's RHIC collider from 2000 to 2016.
summary.technical: Collaboration formed August 1991 from the merger of the TALES, SPARC, OASIS and DIMUON proposals; operated the PHENIX detector at RHIC IP8 from first collision (2000-06-15) to the end of data taking (2016).
